title: eriosyce elquiensis
intro: Eriosyce elquiensis, commonly known as the Elqui cactus, is a species of flowering plant in the cactus family. It is native to Chile and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Elqui cactus has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of Eriosyce elquiensis include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
